text:
Alex K: kicking off a short experiment: rapid-swap design partner track — 4-week cycles, smaller cohorts (2-3 partners), get faster feedback and reduce overfitting.
Maria Chen: love it. main Qs: what incentives? and do we offer Dedicated/Private for partners?
Owen Patel: +1 on incentives. also need clarity on NDAs and data residency requirements for Private.
Neha Singh: success metrics we should track: integration time, qualitative NPS, number of actionable bugs, prompt drift. propose a go/no-go threshold: NPS >= 7 and <=3 blocking bugs.
Alex K: rough incentive plan: $1k stipend + extended trial on Dedicated for willing partners; expedited support + CE call.
Alex K: NDAs: shared template yes; for Private/on-prem we'll use enterprise legal path. ops: @deploy-bot can we flag which partners need on-prem kit?
deploy-bot: checklist created: 1) NDA signed 2) infra needs doc 3) comms channel 4) SLA expectations. Link: https://go/repo/partner-checklist
Maria Chen: cadence suggestion:
```
Week 0: kickoff (1h) + environment setup
Week 1: async tasks + 10min pulse survey
Week 2: joint session (pair debugging) + recording
Week 3: retrospective + final survey + decision
```
Neha Singh: add short eval harness: 5 prompt sets, baseline run, regression monitor. we want automated alerts when quality delta > 8%.
Owen Patel: rollout gates: must have infra baseline perf (p95 < 400ms), security review complete, and at least one critical path integration tested.
Maria Chen: recruitment script draft: "we're running a 4-week rapid feedback cohort to help shape our private deployment flow. commitment: 4 weeks, ~3 hrs total/week. stipend + early private access." Thoughts?
Alex K: sounds good. action items:
- Maria: finalize outreach copy + recruitment tracking (due Tue)
- Neha: assemble eval harness + threshold definitions (due Wed)
- Owen: confirm NDA + infra template availability (due Thu)
- Deploy-bot: mark partner infra needs in tracker
Everyone: thumbs if aligned :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: 👍
Owen Patel: 👍
Neha Singh: 👍
Alex K: merging this into the beta playbook doc after these items.
